audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining ax:lnot1; replacing the displayed formulas with instances of ax:lnot1.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Substituting false for B in ax:lnot2 gives each displayed premise exactly.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is ax:lnot2 the exact schema instantiated by both formulas used before the deduction theorem?

audited_source_corrections.action: Made explicit that both identity propositions concern closed terms, matching the only identity axiom schemas available in this calculus.

audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the overbroad statements; broadening the axiom schemas to all terms.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The proofs use ax:id1 and ax:id2 directly, so their stated closed-term side condition must also govern the derived propositions.
